facts.significance: Gateway to Norwegian fjords and glaciers

climate.description: Oceanic climate with cool summers and cold winters

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Access via tender boats from cruise ships
gettingThere.walkingTime: 5-15 minutes—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Quayside / village staging area — shops/excursion desks mentioned on secondary guides only; authority confirms quay + tender model — keep visit short until village minutes verified.
Loen Skylift — via shuttle or Loen tender — duration not verified on authority HTML.
thingsToDo.shortCall: ≥4 h. Exit 30 + quayside/village loop 60 + return 30 + 75 min buffer ≈ 195. Skip glacier/Skylift unless pre-booked with proven timing.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask whether you are alongside Olden, Olden Cruise Park tender, or Loen tender before any village walk plan.
